messages.body_plain:
I run TitanCNA but meet some problems, following is my R code:
library(TitanCNA)
infile<- read.delim("chr1_c.txt",header = TRUE)
data <- loadAlleleCounts(infile, genomeStyle = "NCBI", sep = "\t",header = TRUE)
numClusters <- 2
params <- loadDefaultParameters(copyNumber=5,numberClonalClusters=numClusters)
cnData <- correctReadDepth("tum_reads_chr1.wig","norm_reads_chr1.wig","gc_chr1.wig","chr1.w1000.map.wig",genomeStyle = "NCBI",targetedSequence = NULL)
logR <- getPositionOverlap(data$chr,data$position,cnData)
data$logR <- log(2^logR)
data <- filterData(data,chrs = NULL,minDepth = 10,maxDepth = 200,positionList = NULL,centromeres = NULL,centromere.flankLength = 0,map = NULL)
write.table(data, file='filterdata',quote = F,sep = '\t',row.names = F,col.names = F)
params <- loadDefaultParameters(copyNumber=5, numberClonalClusters=numClusters, data=data)
params$normalParams$n_0 <- 0.5
params$ploidyParams$phi_0 <- 2
convergeParams <- runEMclonalCN(data,gParams=params$genotypeParams,nParams=params$normalParams,
                                pParams=params$ploidyParams,sParams=params$cellPrevParams,
                                maxiter=20,maxiterUpdate=1500,txnExpLen=1e15,txnZstrength=1e5,
                                useOutlierState=FALSE,
                                normalEstimateMethod="map",estimateS=TRUE,estimatePloidy=TRUE)
optimalPath <- viterbiClonalCN(data,convergeParams)
outwigToRangedData <- paste("test_cluster0",numClusters,"_titan.txt",sep="")

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

The error comes up here:
logR <- getPositionOverlap(data$chr,data$position,cnData)

This line of code finds the overlap of the positions in your file chr1_c.txt with the 1kb regions in your wig files.  Can you confirm that the positions in this file do indeed overlap some of these regions?

>From this error below, it appears that none of your 43157 positions overlap with cnData

  arguments imply differing number of rows: 43157, 0
Calls: getPositionOverlap -> data.frame

Best,
Gavin

messages.subject: Re: runEMclonalCN unknown instruction code error
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

The inference step using forwards-backwards algorithm (fwdBack) analyzes each chromosome in parallel.  It appears that you have included 24 chromosomes, presumably including chrY.  I would recommend that you not analyze chrY.  You can use the filterData function to specify the chromosomes to analyze.

Hope this helps,
Gavin
